title: Range as the engine — a sin x + b cos x, and impossibility

board_content.text: Example 5 — range of 5 sin x − 12 cos x + 3
So $5\sin x - 12\cos x \in [-13,13]$; adding $3$ shifts the whole interval.
Example 6 — when no solution can exist
$\sin x = \frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}$. By AM\u2013GM this is $\ge 1$, but $\sin x \le 1$.
The bounded range turns a trig equation into an inequality constraint.

segments_english.text: Example five shows the range fact doing real work.
For five sine x minus twelve cosine x, the amplitude R is the square root of five squared plus twelve squared, which is thirteen.
So that combination ranges from minus thirteen to thirteen. The plus three at the end just shifts the whole window up.
So f of x runs from minus thirteen plus three to thirteen plus three, that is minus ten to sixteen. No calculus needed, just the amplitude.
Example six is the advanced version, where the range fact rules out solutions entirely.
We're asked to solve sine x equals a squared plus b squared over two a b. By the arithmetic-mean geometric-mean inequality, that right side is at least one. But sine x can never exceed one.
So a solution exists only when the right side is exactly one, which forces a equal to b in magnitude, and then sine x equals one, giving x equal to pi over two plus two n pi.
That's the deep move: the fact that the size of sine is at most one converts a trig equation into a pure inequality constraint on a and b.

segments_hinglish.text: Example पाँच range fact को असली काम करते दिखाता है.
Five sine x minus twelve cosine x के लिए, amplitude R है square root of five squared plus twelve squared, यानी thirteen.
So ये combination minus thirteen से thirteen तक range करता है. आख़िर का plus three पूरी window ऊपर shift कर देता है.
So f of x चलता है minus thirteen plus three से thirteen plus three तक, यानी minus ten to sixteen. Calculus नहीं चाहिए, बस amplitude.
Example छह advanced version है, जहाँ range fact solutions को पूरी तरह ख़ारिज कर देता है.
पूछा है solve कीजिए sine x equals a squared plus b squared over two a b. A M G M inequality से, वो right side कम से कम one है. पर sine x कभी one से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता.
So solution तभी है जब right side exactly one हो, जो a को b के बराबर magnitude में force करता है, और तब sine x equals one, यानी x equals pi over two plus two n pi.
यही deep move है: sine का size ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा one होना एक trig equation को a और b पर pure inequality constraint बना देता है.
